title: 第2081章 李娅沉浸式的修炼第2080章 万法复苏
content_zh:
对于如今诸天万界的变化，所有的强者都是极为的兴奋。
当然，从中也是体会到了危机。
而这也是为什么林无敌如此着急想要得到萧天身上宝物的原因。
要知道太古时代，有名的宝物可不是只有一剑！
最顶级的太古混沌至宝可是有着十件！
而混沌神珠只是其中之一！
只要是其中之一拥有者，那战力也是跟萧天一样强大无比！
当然了，其他级别的混沌至宝也是有着不少。
所以说，诸天万界之中，强大的可不仅仅是萧天和林无敌这样的。
还有很多，以前没有出现过的。
当然，神界下来的强者那就更加不用说了！
随着九天十地来人，也是让诸天万界变得更加的复杂。
当然，现在很多强者并不知道有九天十地的强者过来。
要是知道了估计都会被震惊到！
要知道知道九天十地是什么地方。
而知道这个地方的强者那都是各大势力的巨头。
这些人物一般都是在闭关闭关。
所以，知道的是九天十地的强者的估计并不多。
当然了，要是遇到的话还是能够认出来的。
比较九天十地强者气息上还是有着很大的差别。

当然了，能够遇到，那也是对方想让你遇到，如果对方不想让你遇到的话，估计也很难碰得上。
要知道那些强者实力恐怖，手段更是层出不穷，要想隐藏自己，那还是相当的简单的。
一旦隐藏起来，一般强者也是根本就找不到。
随着妖孽大比这个消息的传递开，一时间所有强者也是极为的兴奋。
妖孽大比，只要自认是绝世妖孽的都可以参加大比。
至于最后能够走到那一步，那就不是现在需要想的。
“妖孽大比，这个听着就很高级！”
“高级不觉得，就是比较直接，如果不是妖孽那都没有资格参加！”
“就是这个妖孽是不是太过笼统，到底怎样才算是妖孽？都没有一个标准。”
“这倒也是！不过像林无敌这种的应该算是妖孽了吧！”
“那是当然，林无敌林大人那可是林家的超级天才，自然算是妖孽。当然了，在林家妖孽可不止林无敌一个超级妖孽！”
“哦！林家难不成还有其他超级妖孽？”
“那是自然！林家作为超级妖孽，比林无敌矮一辈的必然也是超级妖孽的。我听说林家的另一个妖孽修为虽然比林无敌稍微低一些，但是战力却也是丝毫不弱，只是一直在林家闭关，并没有出现在世人的眼中。”
“这么厉害！林无敌听说手中有着强大的宝物，所以才会在短时间内突破到了现如今的这个境界。难不成另外的一个林家妖孽也拥有着另外的宝物！”
“那是自然！林无敌手中的宝物听说并不完整，所有林无敌才会去找那个萧天。而那个萧天手中也是有着那个宝物的一半！也不知道真的假的！”
“嗯，应该是真的，这可是从林家传出来的，而林家还传出了来了，要是能够得到一半，献给林家可以获得强大的宝物！还能得到林家的承诺！这可是千金难买的东西！”
“我去，看来林家还真是下血本了！”
“那是自然，这可是关乎到林无敌的发展的，怎么可能不下血本。只是那可是在萧天手上。我想没人傻到去萧天手上夺取宝物！那可是连林无敌都奈何不了的强者！我们去那就是跟送死没有什么区别！”
“好像也是！那个萧天实力强大，在他手上的东西要想拿过来可不是一件容易的事情。”
“难怪林家会出这么丰厚的报酬，这是没有办法了！他们林家除非全部出动，否则还真不一定是是那个萧天的对手。”

“这话也没有错，那个萧天来历极为的神秘，战力更是恐怖！要是那个小子突破到阳神境的话，就更加的强悍了！”
content_en:
All the powerful people are extremely excited about the changes in the world today.
Of course, we also experienced the crisis.
And this is why Lin Wudi is so anxious to get Xiao Tian's treasure.
You must know that in the ancient times, the only famous treasure was not just a sword!
There are ten of the top ancient chaos treasures!
And the Chaos God Bead is just one of them!
As long as you are the owner of one of them, your combat power will be as powerful as Xiao Tian!
Of course, there are many other levels of Chaos Treasures.
Therefore, among all the worlds, Xiao Tian and Lin Wudi are not the only ones who are powerful.
There are many more that have not appeared before.
Of course, not to mention the strong men who came down from the God Realm!
With the arrival of people from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, the world has become more complicated.
Of course, many powerful people now don't know that there are powerful people from Nine Heavens and Ten Earths coming over.
If you knew it, you would probably be shocked!
You must know where the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths are.
And the powerful people who know this place are all giants of the major forces.
These characters are generally in retreat.
Therefore, what is known is that there are not many powerful people in Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.
Of course, you can still recognize it if you encounter it.
There is still a big difference in the auras of the powerful men in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.
Of course, if you can meet someone, that's because the other party wants you to meet them. If the other party doesn't want you to meet them, it's probably very difficult to meet them.
You must know that those strong people are terrifying in strength and have endless methods. It is quite simple to hide themselves.
Once hidden, the average strong person cannot be found at all.
As the news of the Monster Competition spread, all the powerful men were extremely excited for a while.
The Monster Competition, anyone who thinks they are a peerless monster can participate in the competition.
As for getting to that point in the end, that's not what we need to think about now.
"Monster Competition, this sounds very advanced!"
"I don't think so, senior. It's just more straightforward. If you're not a monster, you're not qualified to participate!"
"Is this monster too general? What does it mean to be a monster? There is no standard."
"That's true! But people like Lin Wudi should be considered monsters!"
"Of course, Lin Wudi, Lord Lin, is a super genius of the Lin family, so he is naturally a monster. Of course, there are more than just super monsters in the Lin family, Lin Wudi!"
"Oh! Is it possible that there are other super monsters in the Lin family?"
"That's natural! As super monsters of the Lin family, those who are a generation shorter than Lin Wudi must also be super monsters. I heard that although another monster of the Lin family has a slightly lower cultivation level than Lin Wudi, his combat power is not weak at all. He has just been in seclusion in the Lin family and has not appeared in the eyes of the world."
"So powerful! Lin Wudi heard that he had a powerful treasure in his hand, so he broke through to the current state in a short period of time. Could it be that another Lin family monster also possesses another treasure!"
"That's natural! I heard that the treasure in Lin Wudi's hand was incomplete, so Lin Wudi went to look for that Xiao Tian. And that Xiao Tian also had half of the treasure in his hand! I don't know if it's true or not!"
"Well, it should be true. This is from the Lin family, and the Lin family has also spread it. If you can get half of it, you can get a powerful treasure by dedicating it to the Lin family! You can also get the Lin family's promise! This is something that a lot of money can't buy!"
"I'll go, it seems that the Lin family has really spent a lot of money!"
"That's natural. This is related to Lin Wudi's development. How can we not spend a lot of money? It's just that it's in Xiao Tian's hands. I don't think anyone is stupid enough to seize the treasure from Xiao Tian's hands! That's a strong man who can't even do anything to Lin Wudi! If we go there, it's no different than committing suicide!"
"It seems so! That oneXiao Tian is very powerful, and it is not easy to get the things in his hands. "
"No wonder the Lin family offers such a generous reward, there is nothing we can do about it! Unless all of the Lin family is dispatched, they may not be Xiao Tian's opponent. "
"That's true. The origin of Xiao Tian is extremely mysterious, and his combat power is even more terrifying! If that kid breaks through to the Yangshen realm, he will be even more powerful! "
